one_month_reasoning: No earnings in the window: Q4 2026 results come in late January 2027 (Trefis/company pattern; Q4 2025 was reported 2026-01-22, src 5). Scheduled or likely items: possible announcement of the 'couple' of advanced-packaging customers the CEO expects within two quarters (src 6), a mild positive; continued PC data points (IDC/Gartner Q4 trackers land in January, outside); the shareholder class action and holder sales (Nvidia trimmed its stake, reported 2026-11-18) are overhangs already in the price; the December FOMC is a sector-wide macro print. After a ~58% fall from the June peak and a +7.5%/-7% swing week, both reversal and momentum effects are live and roughly offset. So the ladder is a symmetric lognormal at today's $59.66 with monthly sigma = 86% / 3.5 = 24.6%, no drift.

downside.story: P10: PC units fall ~20% in 2027 (memory prices stay at 5x, OEMs keep cutting), CCPG ~$23B at ~18% margin; server supply relief arrives just as AMD/Arm price aggressively so DCAI misses by 15% at ~36% margins; foundry losses widen with 14A start-up and no external anchor customer; 2027 capex ~$28B with negative FCF and the market pays ~24x for trough-ish EPS.

base.story: Q4 lands near the midpoint; CCPG falls 16% in 2027 and recovers 7% in 2028 at 22-25% margins; DCAI ships ~$36B in 2027 and ~$42B in 2028 at ~40% margins, still supply-capped through H1 2027; foundry losses narrow from ~$7.8B to $6.0B; FY2027 EPS ~$1.38 (in line with consensus), FY2028 ~$2.05 (15% below); capex ~$26B with FCF ~-$4B in 2027; the multiple shrinks from 43.5x toward 38x.

upside.story: P90: memory prices roll over in H1 2027 and the PC decline is ~-5%; substrates and wafers loosen early so DCAI ships ~$42B in 2027 with 10% price held; a named 14A anchor customer and the two packaging customers cut the foundry loss by 40% and re-rate the stock toward its June peak multiple.

reasoning: Primary-document build. The Q3 2026 release and call (src 2, 6) set the near-term path: Q4 revenue $15-16B with CCPG down >20% q/q (OEM inventory cut after a memory-driven pull-in, IDC src 13), DCAI up mid-teens and supply-capped into H1 2027, a dated $300M/200bp Israel fab hit, no positive FCF in 2027 and capex up strongly. The 2026 beats came from channel pull-in, so we do not add the record beat to Q4 (guidance_check). FY2027 revenue $66.0B (consensus $69.1B, src 9: -4.5%, mainly a deeper CCPG fall), GAAP EPS ~$1.38 (consensus $1.371), FY2028 $74.8B / $2.05 (consensus $83.8B / $2.42: -11% / -15%, because we keep foundry losses at $6B and do not assume 14A external revenue). Valuation: P/E on our NTM EPS at the shrink-rule exit multiple (38.1x) plus a mid-cycle leg at the peer median; research target (12m) $69.3, +16% vs $59.66. Downside (P10 $30.3) moves PC, server revenue and both margins and widens foundry losses with a -11 turn multiple; upside (P90 $124.4) has memory relief, early supply and a foundry anchor. Sell-side after the print cut targets to $70-100 (src 10, 11) with KeyBanc at $140 (src 11, 12); used as context only. Research was limited by the shared web-fetch budget: only three guided quarters could be scored and no current full-year IDC unit forecast number was found.

model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) exit k: 0.8 default gives 38.1x and a $69.3 research target (12m); k=0.6 (own multiple on a cyclically depressed FY2027) gives 33.4x and ~$62.8 (-9%). (4) Equity raise: FY2027 FCF ~-$4.2B on $54.0B cash+ST investments; probability of a new equity raise by the horizon judged ~10% (<20%), not in financing_events.
